+setup:

+      cluster_features: [ "search.retriever.rescorer.enabled" ]

+
+  - do:
+      indices.create:
+        index: test

+            number_of_shards: 1
+            number_of_replicas: 0
+          mappings:

+                type: boolean
+              features:
+                type: rank_features

+          - '{"index": {"_id": 2 }}'

+
+---
+"Rescorer retriever basic":
